# Settings only in config

`W15` · Coding rule

Config via config('…') backed by .env; env() only inside config/ or a module's config/; no hardcoded API keys/paid-API URLs; tell the user which env var to set on staging

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-web|Web app coding rules]].
